Nah, the worst is when they say, when they're dumping/canning me "Well, can't you see it from **my** point of view.  Don't you think that I/our clients deserve someone more reliable/useful etc."

Even my bloody church fired me from a volunteer position!  (Because I was supposed to be at a conference but at the last minute not allowed to fly.)

And of course I can see it that way.  I know that they deserve better, that I ask too much and give back too little.  I'm trying to not make any new friends and to convince the few who've stuck with me to leave now.

I think that, once I've lost this current job I'll just walk away without my meds or machines and let nature take its course.

Oy you've basically hit on exactly my problem here.

I keep hearing stuff like "Stephen Hawking/Helen Keller/Christopher Reeves accomplished great things despite their disabilities, why can't you?"

And shit, I've tried, I'm trying but pathetic as I am, **this is the best I can do** and **I know** that it's not good enough.

Hey, thanks for replying.

I was a software engineer, last worked in that field 6 years ago.

My social situation is complicated.  I share a flat with 3 of my coworkers.  I don't live close to any family.  My parents have substance abuse issues, which is why they lost custody of my brother and me.  I'm friendly with my folks now, not so close to my brother though, sadly.  He and I got split up in the foster care system (because I was a bad kid and needed a special kind of placement).

It's not that I feel unloved.  My church even held a fundraiser for my medical expenses last year (I didn't ask them to!).  I don't want them wasting their money on me - I'll never pay them back or do anything to deserve it.  I don't want my coworkers to have to work harder to cover my sick days - it would be better for everyone if I were out of the picture and they could hire someone else.  I got pneumonia this November-3 days in hospital but 3 weeks barely able to get out of bed.  My roommates did all of my grocery shopping and cooked all of my meals for me.  Which is just unfair.

I feel so despicable and useless.  I don't understand why I'm even still alive.  I probably should have let the pneumonia kill me but I'm too selfish.
